title: What Remains
synopsis: 108 days after a gigantic biomechanical object appears in Earth's orbit, the international crew of the ship Erebus launches a first-contact mission and opens a dialogue with an ancient silicon intelligence — about what separates living matter from its simulation, and what remains after the end.
awards: Winner — K-Culture AI International Film Festival (KCAIF) 2026
Finalist — Seoul International AI Film Festival 2026
